en: Ratings: rate tracks 1 to 5 by clicking the marks on the album file's new TRACKS page or on the signal profile card, or with Ctrl+1 – Ctrl+5 (Ctrl+0 clears). They are kept in JSplitter's own database, so no file is written, or in foo_playcount's statistics when it is installed; right-click the Archive › Ratings saved in to pick file tags instead.
Archive: the album file has a second page listing every track with its rating, so a library can be browsed and rated without opening a playlist; the two dots at its bottom, or L, turn the page.
Archive: Shift + wheel (or a sideways wheel) switches shelves, as ← → do; in the grid it jumps a section.
A halftone of dots on the album file and the signal profile card: along the bottom, in the lower right corner or off, faint to strong (05 STYLE › HALFTONE, DOTS).
Startup: with a large library of CUE albums, 1.7.1 could make foobar2000 report the Archive's script as not responding (#24). The CUE sheets are now read a little at a time, and each folder once.
Archive: CUE sheets saved in a Japanese or Chinese code page (as EAC writes them) are read, so their albums show as their tracks too.
zh: 评分：在专辑档案新的 曲目 页或信号资料卡上点击菱形为曲目评 1 至 5 分，或按 Ctrl+1 – Ctrl+5 （Ctrl+0 清除）。评分默认保存在 JSplitter 自带的数据库中，不写入文件；装有 foo_playcount 时保存在其播放统计中；也可在右键档案 › 评分保存在 中改为文件标签。
档案：专辑档案新增第二页，列出全部曲目及其评分，无需打开播放列表即可浏览与评分；点击底部的两个圆点或按 L 翻页。
档案： Shift + 滚轮（或横向滚轮）切换货架，与 ← → 相同；网格中跳到相邻分区。
专辑档案与信号资料卡加入半调网点装饰：沿底部、在右下角或关闭，浓淡可调（05 外观 › 半调网点、浓度）。
启动：媒体库中有大量 CUE 专辑时，1.7.1 可能让 foobar2000 提示档案脚本无响应（#24）。现在 CUE 分轨分批读取，每个文件夹只读一次。
档案：以日文或中文编码保存的 CUE（EAC 常见）现在也能读取，这些专辑同样按分轨显示。
